note: The Bristol Trading Competition on /books/competition/ (js/books-comp.js). The trading week is scored from each book's daily account values in books/data/<book>.json. Pitch points are entered by hand after the pitch: "pitch": { "ficc-aled": 25, ... }, keyed by book id. Set "final": true once every team's export to the last day is in. Results (places and points) stay hidden until "reveal": true; add ?preview=1 to the page address to check them before then. The Floor hides every book's figures until floorRevealAt (UTC; 20:00 is 8 pm in the UK in November) or reveal, whichever comes first.
